Hotel Sales & Representation

Global Hotel Representation from India

A multi-market hotel sales programme needs one primary owner per account and consistent reporting across territories.

Discuss your project

Assign lead markets and account owners

Map India-origin buyers separately from buyers headquartered in another territory. Give multinational accounts one primary owner and define when local teams can originate proposals.

Use one measurement standard

Share definitions of active account, confirmed booking and consumed room nights. Record results in the booking currency and agree how the portfolio team will compare markets.
